content:
Analyzing the datasheet: FTLC1155RGPL3 is a single 100G CWDM4 QSFP28 with four lane wavelength ranges in one optical table row, 25.78125 Gb/s per lane (103.1 Gb/s aggregate), CAUI-4 / 4×25G retimed host, RS-FEC on host (5 dB budget note), unstressed Rx −11.3 dBm and stressed −8.9 dBm as test conditions—not separate apps. No amplified/unamplified split; no penalties in the input. Four schema fields require one wavelength pair per mode, so four lane modes with shared non-wavelength parameters.
